selectionOutcomes.description: Determines how the authenticated user's access to the source file is checked and obtains the file before processing.
Binds supplied collection_name to the processing path and constructs the source documents/content that may be written.
Invokes save_docs_to_vector_db with the user, selected collection_name, documents, and add flag; this is the primary downstream write boundary.
Records the selected collection_name and completed status after the vector-database operation succeeds.
Non-admin requests resolve the file through the user-scoped lookup, establishing the source-file ownership gate.
The request form exposes collection_name as a caller-supplied optional field.
The supplied collection name is assigned directly, with a default used only when it is absent.
When collection_name is supplied, the handler obtains the file content and prepares documents for the selected collection.
An existing collection is retained for insertion when add is true; this control path contains no user ownership or write-grant check.
The handler passes the caller-selected collection_name and sets add to true whenever collection_name was supplied, forwarding the verified user to the vector-save operation.
The vector-save operation inserts the prepared items into the selected collection and reports success.
After a successful vector write, the selected collection name is recorded on the file and the completed response is returned.
